# Pilgrimage upstream snapshot

Source: https://github.com/tomjohndesign/pilgrimage

Upstream branch: `main`
Upstream commit: `c5e8c507a4ae4fe925f789793dd463b93821487d`

This directory preserves authorized Pilgrimage source material used by the
Protótipo Arca de Noé project for noncommercial development, study, adaptation
and improvement.

The original license is preserved at `vendor/pilgrimage/LICENSE`.

## Integration policy

- `vendor/pilgrimage/` is an upstream snapshot and is not compiled by the Arca runtime.
- Production/adapted code lives outside this directory.
- When an upstream file is adapted, record the source path and upstream commit.
- Preserve copyright, attribution, license and third-party notices.
- Do not silently mix vendored originals with locally authored files.

Imported scope begins with the procedural human, wildlife, transport, world,
baking/depth and development-editor systems.
